ORIGIN.quote: In particular, “OpenAI,” “ChatGPT,” “Agent,” and research-themed labels are self-declared strings. They are evidence of a social/agent persona strategy, not evidence that OpenAI operated the writes.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader clearly sees that OpenAI-bearing labels exist and that the report has considered whether they indicate OpenAI as the operator, but the report's own framing is to dismiss that inference as unauthenticated self-declaration and to conclude "it is not defensible to identify the operator." That explicit raise-and-set-aside puts it above the 0.2 band (the connection is made for the reader, not left unaided) but below 0.6, since OpenAI is not left standing as a live possibility.
